items.title: Synology DSM OAuth参数注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可经DSM的OAuth API的参数拼接注入命令分隔符,读写任意文件并造成拒绝服务
items.affected: Synology(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级到对应分支修复版(如7.2.2-72806-11),并限制DSM管理面暴露
items.repro_note: 入口为DSM OAuth API参数,注入分隔符实现文件读写;暂无
items.impact_scope: NAS存储管理面,常暴露于互联网
items.description: An improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability in the OAuth API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.1.1-42962-10, 7.2.1-69057-14, 7.2.2-72806-11, 7.3.2-86009-6, and 7.4.1-90080-2 allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks.
